newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Antah seen securing privatisation project.
newsitem.headline: Antah seen securing privatisation project.

text.p: Antah Holdings Bhd is expected to soon announce it has received a toll road privatisation project worth about one billion ringgit, senior stock market sources said on Tuesday.
Shares of the property developer were suspended on Tuesday at the company's request.
An official at Antah, when contacted for comment, said a statement would be issued in two or three days.

The stock market sources said Antah had been awarded a project to build and operate a 45-km toll road in the central states of Selangor and Negeri Sembilan. The toll concession is for 30 years, the sources said.
Shares of Antah closed at 3.38 ringgit on Monday.
